transfer_taxes.name: Georgia real estate transfer tax
transfer_taxes.source_title: Georgia DOR: Real Estate Transfer Tax
transfer_taxes.notes: $1 for first $1,000 plus $0.10 per additional $100 (= 0.1%). Seller liable; contract may shift to buyer. Base excludes pre-existing liens not removed by sale (O.C.G.A. 48-6-1, https://law.justia.com/codes/georgia/title-48/chapter-6/article-1/section-48-6-1).

transfer_taxes.name: Georgia intangible recording tax (on long-term note)
transfer_taxes.notes: $1.50 per $500 of note face amount; maximum $25,000 per note. Legally collected from the note holder (lender), who may pass it to the borrower; customarily borrower-paid closing cost.
